detail.longDescription: Do # design agencies just not exist anymore? Every job ad from the past 8 months has been from big tech, a company looking for a # dev for their own site, or a recruiting agency hiding the company’s name. Even when finding a potential job you might fit, you can never get past the AI screener, even when using other AI apps to “optimize" your resume & cover letters. It all feels like one big grift. # fedihire # fedijobs # freelancing # webdev # frontend # wordpress # webdevelopment # html # css
